    Kronecker bricks of singular dimension #

    Let κ > |k| be singular, μ = cf κ, λ = (max μ |k|)⁺ < κ. Take a pool of λ orthogonal bricks (Bricks.transportPool), cofinal regular cardinals κ_i > λ (i < μ) with ∑ κ_i = κ, and transport the rigid structure of κ_i along the sub-seed {i} × ℕ of the pool. The transports H_i are pairwise orthogonal bricks of dimension κ_i; glued over a new anchor they give a brick of dimension κ (Bricks.exists_brick_singular). With the regular case this proves KroneckerBricksLarge (Bricks.kroneckerBricksLarge), the remaining part of Göbel–Simson, Corollary 1.3.

    ∃ (_ : IsRegularCardinalOrder κ.ord.ToType) (_ : Nonempty κ.ord.ToType) (_ : NoMaxOrder κ.ord.ToType), Cardinal.aleph0 < Order.cof κ.ord.ToType ∧ Cardinal.mk κ.ord.ToType = κ
